lc_person: William John Bossenbrook (1897-1984), Wayne State University history professor; author of The German Mind (1961) and editor of Mid-twentieth Century Nationalism (1965).
item_person: John William Spencer, known as Johnny Spencer (1897-1984), baseball outfielder active in 1921-1922.

evidence.says: LC authorizes Bossenbrook, William J. (William John), 1897-1984. Its source for The German Mind (1961) identifies him as Professor of History, Wayne State University; another source identifies his editorship of Mid-twentieth Century Nationalism (1965). The record supports birth year 1897, lists VIAF 98406457 and GND 104920718, and links Q101116062 as a close external authority.

Karl H. L. Welker, History of Law as Legal Policy: Justus Möser as a Jurist and Statesman, footnote 80, cites William John Bossenbrook, Justus Möser as an Historian, unpublished doctoral dissertation, Chicago, 1932. This matches the graph’s AHA dissertation author, subject, institution and year.

Identifies Johnny Spencer as John William Spencer (1897-1984), a baseball outfielder in 1921-1922. Its Wikidata item link points to Q101116062; its authority-control links include LC no2001078952 and VIAF 98406457, showing that the historian’s identifiers are attached to the baseball biography.

The Johnny Spencer player record gives the full name John William Spencer, life years 1897-1984, and outfield appearances for the Homestead Grays and Pittsburgh Keystones in 1921-1922, independently corroborating the baseball identity.

notes: The identical life years conceal two different people. LC’s backlink to Q101116062 repeats the mismatch. Direct Wikidata page/API requests failed; the supplied item labels and Wikipedia’s explicit Q101116062 link establish the item identity. No separate QID for Bossenbrook was found.
